title: refuses … a record with no owner
when: Moves a view, which has no owner, under the product.
then: Expects a `command` refusal saying a view has no parent, so it cannot move.

title: refuses a record others reference, saying what references it
when: Removes a requirement that a step fulfills and a test sits under, a pattern setting a rule names, and a value object a field is typed by.
then: Expects each refused as `referenced`, its message naming every link and row that references the record.

title: The merge fails when one ID is added on both sides with different content
when: Merges a view file whose ours and theirs each add `TL-V02`, one titled `Desk` and the other `Return desk`.
then: Expects the clash `TL-V02 was added on both sides with different content`, and the merged text holding both versions between `<<<<<<< ours`, `=======` and `>>>>>>> theirs`.

title: An ID another record has, of any kind, is refused
when: For each kind, loads a record with the ID of another kind's record, and a second row with the same ID in its own file.
then: Expects a record with another kind's ID refused.

title: A missing, unknown or disallowed parent is refused, as is a second parent or a parent column on a kind with no owner
when: An aggregate with no domain or an unknown one, an endpoint, table or question with two parents or none, and a product or a kind with no owner given a parent column are loaded.
then: Each is refused; an endpoint under its query and a question under its product load.

title: refuses an ID that does not start with its parent's or domain's ID
when: Loads a UC requirement whose ID starts with another use case's ID than its parent's.
then: Expects an `id-prefix` refusal naming the parent and the prefix its ID must start with.

title: A link whose relation is unknown or not allowed for its kinds is refused
when: Adds a second `documents` pair (cli_command to integration), then links a CLI command `documents` a UC requirement, a query `calls` a use case, a use case `calls` a domain service, and a use case `teaches` itself.
then: Expects a `relation-pair` refusal saying `TL-LEND-CMD01-CLI (a cli_command) cannot documents TL-LEND-UC01-R01 (a uc_requirement)`, `foreign-key` refusals naming no `domain_service` and no `calls_source (command, query, read_model)`, and an `unknown-relation` refusal for `teaches`.

title: A link from a record of one product to a record of another is refused, whatever the relation; an ID in text is not a link
when: Points the flow step `EX-LEND-UC02-FL01-S01` of product EX to happen in `NX-V01`, a view of a second product.
then: Expects one `link-crosses-product` refusal on `happens_in` saying `EX-LEND-UC02-FL01-S01 is in product EX`.

title: a command and a specification in different domains
when: Loads a command that checks a specification of another domain.
then: Expects a `link-scope` refusal on `checks.jsonl` saying `checks` links records of one domain.

title: A space's index holds only its product's records, links, parts, coverage and problems, and the records and problems of no product
when: Builds the Demo shop and Notebook space indexes from a workspace where Demo shop's use case follows and names Notebook's `NF-NOTE`, with a use case of no product and a problem on the crossing link.
then: Expects each space's index to hold its own records, parts and those of no product, no link into the other, its own coverage, and its problems with the workspace's.

title: A list splits by kind only when it holds more than one kind, whatever the focus, depth or filters
when: Reads the graph's tree under an aggregate with four kinds of child and a use case with seven UC requirements, frames the aggregate at depth 3 with commands hidden, then opens an endpoint's and a command's pages.
then: Expects an aggregate's children of four kinds in a group each, a use case's seven requirements straight under it, the tree the same after a filtered, deeper neighborhood, and the record page titling a list of one kind by the kind and a mixed one Children.

title: Filters hide kinds and paths through them, never the focus
when: Hides use cases, entities, aggregates and the focus's own kind.
then: Expects the hidden records to go, nothing to be reached through them, a folder gone with its kind while a stage stays, and the focus to stay even when its own kind is hidden.

title: A folder opens only when it holds lathe.config.json or a data folder
when: Builds folders with a `lathe.config.json` that names a data folder or none, with only `data/`, with neither, with a broken config, a plain file and a missing path, and a folder whose `data/product.jsonl` names two products.
then: Expects a configured folder to open on its named data folder or `data`, a plain `data/` folder to open, an empty one refused as having `no lathe.config.json and no data folder`, a broken config refused as `not valid JSON`, a file or a missing path refused; and the window titled `Lathe, Tool Library — ~/Development/Lathe` from the products, or `product — /srv/product` with none.

title: In development the window uses the 5199 server only when it answers for the opened folder
when: Chooses the development source against a fake 5199 that answers for the folder, for another folder, without the header, with an error, or not at all.
then: Expects the shared `http://localhost:5199` when it answers 200 for the opened folder, or names no folder and the folder is the repo; and a server of its own when it names another folder, answers 500, does not answer, or names no folder and the folder is another product.

title: A domain follows a pattern itself or through any of its use cases
when: A domain follows one pattern through its use case and another itself.
then: Expects both rules counted there, each once.

title: A rule whose setting every following use case marks not applicable does not apply in that domain
when: Both following use cases in a domain give the rule's setting a not-applicable reason.
then: Expects the rule neither counted nor reported there.

title: A rule no follower meets is waived in that domain, neither owed nor proved
when: Gives the complete product's pattern rule the applies-when setting `record`, with the value ` tool ` (its follower's `Tool` in other spacing and case), then `Loan`, then `Loan` negated.
then: Expects the rule owed (one rule counted) with the value ` tool `, waived (none counted) with `Loan`, and owed again with `Loan` negated.

title: Each domain that follows a pattern owes its rules, on one pattern rule line
when: Adds a second domain, Shop, whose use case follows the complete product's pattern and gives its setting, with no pattern rule test of its own.
then: Expects EX-LEND's `pattern_rule` line proof-only and covered for its one rule; EX-SHOP's to owe that rule designed and built but not proved; and the gap `Pattern rule EX-PAT-ACT-R01 is not proved yet in EX-SHOP.`
